notes.title: Guncraft goes 100% free, forever on June 10th, 2025!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]On June 10th, 2025, Guncraft will forever be free![/b][/h1]

It's been almost 12 years... I cannot believe it. Exato Games is no more and the team has gone off to do different things. One is working on Minecraft, another on Fortnite, two of us are making our own games, and one went into maker spaces.

But Guncraft lives on!

I keep seeing you all popping up from time to time trying to play and I wanted to help get out of your way so you could do your thing. The VPN method of LAN games is really clever. Good job on that.

There is no point in charging for Guncraft anymore, so we just won't! I hope you all are able to relive some of those great community moments together from time to time. It was a blast!

Get to hookshotting, zipping around in the copter, building fun levels, and blasting robots in the classic genre-shaping voxel shooter, one last time!

I should note that public servers will continue to be offline, but you can access the community Discord in the discussions forum to arrange multiplayer matches with fellow players using the VPN method (selecting the same VPN server and using the LAN feature).

Block and load!

notes.title: Newsletter - What We've Been Waiting For
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

Its time once again for those few minutes of your time we call the Newsletter!  Sorry about that, but I promise you that this will be time well spent.

Lets start with the community.  Do you remember that at the start of the year, we ran the Battle of the Clans competition?  Well judging from the feedback we got back from it, its clear that many of you would be interested in doing it all again.  Thanks in no small part to that feedback, we have decided to do it all again!  We haven't yet set a date for registrations to open, but I can tell you that we will be aiming to have the majority (if not all) of the battles over the school Summer holidays, just so we can try to open up some more times for competitors around the world to beat the everlasting life out of each other!  Keep watching both the [URL=http://www.exatogames.com/forums/index.php?forums/news-announcements.2/]News & Announcements[/URL] and [URL=http://www.exatogames.com/forums/index.php?forums/general-discussion.3/]General Discussion[/URL] sections of the board to get more information as its revealed!

Next up, we have a bit of bittersweet news.  Due to various reasons, it has been decided between the senior staff and himself that [B]Merlock[/B] should leave the team.  I'm sorry to see him go, but on behalf of EGS, I wish him all the best for the future.  However, Merlock's departure means that the Moderating team was left a little bare for a while.  After much discussion, we eventually decided that both [B]Turbozack[/B] and [B]Zusheqiel[/B] are to be promoted to the Mod team!  Let me be the first of many to congratulate you both on your new roles.  Send me an e-mail and I'll get an NDA and instructions to you asap.

And now we've got the comparatively small reports out of the road, its time for the big one!  Yes ladies and gentlemen, on May 15th 2015 at 5:15PM BST, our friend and developer Darknuke dropped me this bombshell:
[quote="Rav3n and Darknuke"](note that we were discussing BotC at the time)

[17:15:24] Darknuke: ... That sounds like a good idea. Might also work when we release Guncraft on Xbox.  We passed cert, but [there's still work to be done].

[17:15:58] Rav3n: oooh, you just made my day!
[17:16:22] Rav3n: and once I get it in the newsletter, it'll make everyone else's as well
[/quote]

Yes, if you didn't catch it in the chat above, let me spell it out for you.

[b]Guncraft has passed Microsoft certification![/b]

This means that in theory, Guncraft: Blocked and Loaded could appear on the virtual shelves from any point from now on.  However, I would ask you all not to expect it immediately, as there are still one or two things the devs need to do in order to be ready for the launch.  Having said that though, the certification was arguably the biggest hurdle that we faced, so now that we're through it, it really won't be long before our little voxel game is sitting on the shelves alongside some of the bigger titles!

When I come to write the next Newsletter, I hope that I'll be able to give everyone a definite launch date!  See you all then!

notes.title: Death Tractor - Farm Simulator... WITH DEATH! (On Greenlight Now!)
notes.notes:
Are you ready for the most insane corn harvesting simulator you've ever experienced?! Prepare yourself, the DEATH TRACTORs are upon you!

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=399993239]VOTE FOR US ON GREENLIGHT[/url]

[url=http://www.deathtractor.com]Death Tractor Website[/url] - Includes a link to play the game!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WtyRypUInug

You are a member of the Nomsanto family. The luck of these average, run of the mill GMO corn farmers goes sour when their loyal tractors get fed up with the modifications the family is making to their corn. They transform into horrendous, murderous death machines hellbent on wiping out the Nomsantos and returning the crops to their pristine state. However, the darkness has also changed the Nomsantos. They've been consumed by their capitalist greed and will stop at nothing to harvest as much profit as they can, even if that means murdering their other family members. How much corn will YOU harvest before your eventual death by tractor? Don't let your family, or the tractors, stop you from becoming the ultimate capitalist in DEATH TRACTOR! 

This totally serious, 100% accurate to life corn harvesting simulation experience will get your adrenaline pumping and nerves excited. You'll never be able to farm for corn in the same light again! 

Features include: 
-4 player online/LAN multiplayer** 
-Multiple levels 
-Accurate corn harvesting physics and real-time growth patterns 
-Tractors so frightening you will dream of nothing but them bearing down over your soul. 
-Gameplay so easy to learn even your Grandma could do it. Until she has a heart attack from the TERRIFYING DEATH TRACTORS. 

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=399993239]VOTE FOR US ON GREENLIGHT[/url] and we'll make this a full fledged game.

notes.title: Guncraft Brings The Boom!
notes.notes:
[I][B]GUNCRAFT[/B][/I][B], THE EPIC VOXEL-BASED FIRST PERSON SHOOTER, AIMS ITS POWER SCOPE AT XBOX 360[/B]

[I]Loaded with New Features Including Exclusive Maps, the Console Version of the PC Sensation to Launch This Year  [/I]

[B]Twain Harte, CA – August 28, 2014 –[/B] Exato Game Studios and indie games partner GameMill Entertainment announced today that [I][B]Guncraft[/B][/I] will be available for digital download on the Xbox 360 games and entertainment system from Microsoft in Q4 2014. The digital version of the indie PC hit published by GameMill Entertainment on the Xbox Live online entertainment network will include a split-screen for intense local hot-seat multiplayer, an all-new levelling system, high-resolution models, and exclusive maps.

Download the all new Xbox Live [I][B]Guncraft [/B][/I]screenshots and video [B][URL='http://click.icptrack.com/icp/relay.php?r=25254777&msgid=507205&act=60VM&c=275324&destination=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.hightail.com%2Fdownload%2FZUczZm1aTlFVbStKUmNUQw']HERE[/URL][/B]: [URL='http://click.icptrack.com/icp/relay.php?r=25254777&msgid=507205&act=60VM&c=275324&destination=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.hightail.com%2Fdownload%2FZUczZm1aTlFVbStKUmNUQw']www.hightail.com/download/ZUczZm1aTlFVbStKUmNUQw[/URL]

Check out the new [B][I]Guncraft[/I][/B] video on YouTube [B][URL='http://click.icptrack.com/icp/relay.php?r=25254777&msgid=507205&act=60VM&c=275324&destination=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fwatch%3Fv%3DpNTjEYm-O40']HERE[/URL]:[/B] [URL='http://click.icptrack.com/icp/relay.php?r=25254777&msgid=507205&act=60VM&c=275324&destination=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fwatch%3Fv%3DpNTjEYm-O40']www.youtube.com/watch?v=pNTjEYm-O40[/URL]

“The response we have received for [B][I]Guncraft[/I][/B] from the PC community has been nothing short of fantastic, so we’re thrilled to reach even more players by bringing the game to the Xbox 360 platform,” said John Getty, Lead Developer of [B][I]Guncraft[/I][/B] and founder of Exato Game Studios. "[I][B]Guncraft [/B][/I]is the perfect blend of sandbox gameplay, crafting, and intense FPS action.”

Marrying the addictive nature of block building sandbox games with the speed and competition of modern first-person shooters, [I][B]Guncraft[/B][/I] takes voxel-based gaming to a whole new level. Play through dozens of maps, then create your own level with secret tunnels and hiding holes to find the best look out for ambushing your friends.  Players can create arenas based on anything imaginable, and once complete, utterly destroy them with bullets, bombs, grenades, tanks, helicopters and even laser swords. In the heat of battle, soldiers can create custom blockades and fortresses instantaneously.

[I][B]GUNCRAFT [/B][/I][B]XBOX LIVE KEY FEATURES:[/B]

[LIST]
[*]Exclusive Xbox Live maps
[*]Includes all PC DLC
[*]Two-player split-screen local multiplayer
[*]Player-controlled vehicles, perks, killstreaks, class load-outs, clan system, and ranks
[*]Create custom levels, weapons and characters limited only by your imagination
[*]Outlandish game modes for up to 16 players, including:
[LIST]
[*]Lava Survival Mode - where magma slowly rises as players build upward to avoid the instant orange death. It’s a new variation of “Last Man Standing”
[*]Onslaught Mode - Where four players band together to fight off endless waves of deadly robot spiders, soldiers, drones, and aircraft
[*]Spleef Mode - Where players drill and destroy blocks on the platform near or under their opponents in order to cause them to fall to their deaths while fervently moving to avoid suffering the same fate.
[/LIST]
[*]Exclusive levelling system where you earn new rewards with every other level, all the way up to level 550 (50 levels per ReCraft rank - one base, 10 ReCrafted ranks)
[*]New high-resolution models with an unlockable aesthetics system containing 300 pieces of unique gear to customize characters.  Each are individually customizable, giving gamers over 4 billion different combinations
[*]New tutorial system for learning the basics of Guncraft and each game mode
[/LIST]

[I][B]Guncraft[/B][/I] players have all of the standard multiplayer shooter modes such as Deathmatch and Team Deathmatch, plus tons of custom load-outs, perks, plenty of weapons, vehicles and more. Even better, the core crafting mechanics of [I][B]Guncraft[/B][/I] are available throughout every aspect of the game, enabling players to build maps, characters, and weapons on the fly and then decimate it all to take down enemies.

To learn more about [I][B]Guncraft[/B][/I], please visit [URL='http://click.icptrack.com/icp/relay.php?r=25254777&msgid=507205&act=60VM&c=275324&destination=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.exatogames.com%2FGuncraft%2F']www.exatogames.com/Guncraft/[/URL], as well as ‘[URL='http://click.icptrack.com/icp/relay.php?r=25254777&msgid=507205&act=60VM&c=275324&destination=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2FExatoGames']Like[/URL]’ it on Facebook and follow the development [URL='http://click.icptrack.com/icp/relay.php?r=25254777&msgid=507205&act=60VM&c=275324&destination=https%3A%2F%2Ftwitter.com%2FExatoGames']@ExatoGames[/URL] for all the latest developer updates and news.

Come visit us for a hands on look at PAX Prime in Seattle, WA Aug 29 – Sept 1, 2014 at booth #3812

# # #

[B]About Exato Game Studios[/B]
Exato Game Studios was founded on the premise of creating indie games of the highest caliber. Its first title, [I]Guncraft[/I], aims high in its grand goals of pushing the envelope, by offering one of the most diverse, user-driven, and customizable first-person shooters to ever be created.

[B]About GameMill Entertainment[/B]

GameMill Entertainment, located in Minneapolis, Minnesota is a third-party publisher of casual games for the mass market consumer. Development platforms include PC, Nintendo handhelds and consoles including Nintendo DS™ , Nintendo 3DS™ and Wii™, Microsoft consoles including Xbox 360® video game and entertainment system, XBLA, Microsoft Games On Demand and Kinect™ for Xbox 360®, and Sony handhelds and consoles including PlayStation®3 computer entertainment system. With development across the globe, GameMill is a source of entertaining and fun games for all ages. For more information, please visit: [URL='http://click.icptrack.com/icp/relay.php?r=25254777&msgid=507205&act=60VM&c=275324&destination=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.game-mill.com']www.game-mill.com[/URL].

notes.title: Guncraft Brings The Boom!
notes.notes:
[b]GUNCRAFT, THE EPIC VOXEL-BASED FIRST PERSON SHOOTER, AIMS ITS POWER SCOPE AT XBOX 360[/b]

Loaded with New Features Including Exclusive Maps, the Console Version of the PC Sensation to Launch This Year ​

Twain Harte, CA – August 28, 2014 – Exato Game Studios and indie games partner GameMill Entertainment announced today that Guncraft will be available for digital download on the Xbox 360 games and entertainment system from Microsoft in Q4 2014. The digital version of the indie PC hit published by GameMill Entertainment on the Xbox Live online entertainment network will include a split-screen for intense local hot-seat multiplayer, an all-new levelling system, high-resolution models, and exclusive maps.

Download the all new Xbox Live Guncraft screenshots and video HERE: www.hightail.com/download/ZUczZm1aTlFVbStKUmNUQw

Check out the new Guncraft video on YouTube HERE: www.youtube.com/watch?v=pNTjEYm-O40

“The response we have received for Guncraft from the PC community has been nothing short of fantastic, so we’re thrilled to reach even more players by bringing the game to the Xbox 360 platform,” said John Getty, Lead Developer of Guncraft and founder of Exato Game Studios. "Guncraft is the perfect blend of sandbox gameplay, crafting, and intense FPS action.”

Marrying the addictive nature of block building sandbox games with the speed and competition of modern first-person shooters, Guncraft takes voxel-based gaming to a whole new level. Play through dozens of maps, then create your own level with secret tunnels and hiding holes to find the best look out for ambushing your friends. Players can create arenas based on anything imaginable, and once complete, utterly destroy them with bullets, bombs, grenades, tanks, helicopters and even laser swords. In the heat of battle, soldiers can create custom blockades and fortresses instantaneously.

[b][i][u]GUNCRAFT XBOX LIVE KEY FEATURES[/u][/i][/b]:

• Exclusive Xbox Live maps

• Includes all PC DLC 

• Two-player split-screen local multiplayer

• Player-controlled vehicles, perks, killstreaks, class load-outs, clan system, and ranks

• Create custom levels, weapons and characters limited only by your imagination

• Outlandish game modes for up to 16 players, including: 

       o Lava Survival Mode - where magma slowly rises as players build upward to avoid the instant orange death. It’s a new variation of “Last Man Standing” 

       o Onslaught Mode - Where four players band together to fight off endless waves of deadly robot spiders, soldiers, drones, and aircraft

       o Spleef Mode - Where players drill and destroy blocks on the platform near or under their opponents in order to cause them to fall to their deaths while fervently moving to avoid suffering the same fate. 

• Exclusive  levelling system where you earn new rewards with every other level, all the way up to level 550 (50 levels per ReCraft rank - one base, 10 ReCrafted ranks)

• New high-resolution models with an unlockable aesthetics system containing 300 pieces of unique gear to customize characters.  Each are individually customizable, giving gamers over 4 billion different combinations

• New tutorial system for learning the basics of Guncraft and each game mode


Guncraft players have all of the standard multiplayer shooter modes such as Deathmatch and Team Deathmatch, plus tons of custom load-outs, perks, plenty of weapons, vehicles and more. Even better, the core crafting mechanics of Guncraft are available throughout every aspect of the game, enabling players to build maps, characters, and weapons on the fly and then decimate it all to take down enemies.

To learn more about Guncraft, please visit www.exatogames.com/Guncraft/, as well as ‘Like’ it on Facebook and follow the development @ExatoGames for all the latest developer updates and news.

Come visit us for a hands on look at PAX Prime in Seattle, WA Aug 29 – Sept 1, 2014 at booth #3812

# # #

About Exato Game Studios
Exato Game Studios was founded on the premise of creating indie games of the highest caliber. Its first title, Guncraft, aims high in its grand goals of pushing the envelope, by offering one of the most diverse, user-driven, and customizable first-person shooters to ever be created.

GameMill Entertainment, located in Minneapolis, Minnesota is a third-party publisher of casual games for the mass market consumer. Development platforms include PC, Nintendo handhelds and consoles including Nintendo DS™ , Nintendo 3DS™ and Wii™, Microsoft consoles including Xbox 360® video game and entertainment system, XBLA, Microsoft Games On Demand and Kinect™ for Xbox 360®, and Sony handhelds and consoles including PlayStation®3 computer entertainment system. With development across the globe, GameMill is a source of entertaining and fun games for all ages. For more information, please visit: www.game-mill.com.

notes.title: PARANOIA Mode Announced + TONS of new features!
notes.notes:
Here it is, the big Halloween update. YOU wanted it, YOU got it! Paranoia mode is our answer to the overwhelming number of requests for a "zombie" mode, but like most of our modes, we'd never settle for an industry standard, boring ol' zombie mode. Paranoia Mode combines the "Zombies vs Humans" game theme with the tension of a spine-chilling, horror B-movie. At the beginning of the mode, one or two players are secretly selected as the "zombie queen." The zombie queen appears to be a normal Guncraft soldier model but they have the power to turn any human they kill into zombies with enhanced speed and jumping advantages. Humans must band together, survive the swift attacks of zombie hordes, and use special abilities, wits, and teamwork to figure out who the zombie queens are before all humans are converted into minions of the undead horde. [url=http://www.gametrailers.com/videos/jeaboy/guncraft-paranoia-mode-trailer]Check the trailer for it here![/url]

We weren't content with just giving you one thing this Halloween though. We're also giving you Melee Gunsmithing! Now you can create your own melee weapons under the archetypes of the hammer (faster prefab construction), drill (faster mining), sword (high damage), and pickax (all-around).

The Admin Controls Pack also makes its debut. Change gravity, force loadouts, increase player speed, remove hookshots, disable parachutes, disable vehicles, and plenty of other options. Like we've always promised, this is YOUR first person shooter and you should have as many controls as you want to make it exactly how you want.

There's also a slew of minor features that make big changes to your Guncraft play. We've added new customization options to gunsmithing, including duel wield (purely visual) and different attachment regions (left hand, chest, and head). We've also added voice options for the skin crafting, so you can have a male or female character. Secondary weapons have been removed in favor of choosing two primary weapons. You can now rock a shotty/sniper build or double hookshots. Achievement and Badge rewards are also in. Earn various achievements or unlock the trading card badges and you'll find yourself with new skins (for achievements) or new guns (for badge levels). Resolution changes also make there way in! This was the #1 request at Steam launch and we got a lot of flak for not having it, so now we do!

AND FINALLY, we have our first two DLC packs. The Sci-fi and Horror SFX packs. For 99 cents each, you'll unlock new sound effects for weapons, ambiance, and voices. The Sci-fi Pack comes with laser gun sounds, robot voices, and various spacey ambiance noises for maps. The Horror Pack (just in time for Halloween!) comes with several monster voices, a chainsaw melee weapon sound, and several spooky ambiance noises for maps. Again, we'll never release paid DLC for Guncraft that would segment the user base, so these customization features will be our form of DLC. Expect more epic stuff to come out in the near future. We're also working on something extra special that will hopefully come out towards the end of the year.

So, Happy Halloween! We hope it makes your Guncraft experience even better. We're super excited to hear what you have to say about it all.

Block and Load!

tl;dr
-Paranoia Game Mode
-Melee Gunsmithing
-Admin Controls Pack
-New gunsmithing customization options
-Voice effects for skins
-Two primary weapons over primary/secondary
-Achievement/Badge rewards
-Resolution Changing
-Sci-fi and Horror DLC Packs, 99 cents each USD.
